props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Network segmentation, zoning, and isolation platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Policy-defined network trust zones with controlled inter-zone communication.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Network zone definitions, segmentation rules, and inter-zone traffic metadata.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network segmentation enforces explicit trust boundaries and eliminates implicit trust based on network location.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Dynamic segmentation and zone-based isolation support Zero Trust Networking principles.

metadata.remarks: Network Segmentation and Zones defines how the institutional network is divided into explicitly governed trust zones. Each zone represents a bounded risk and trust context. This pattern enforces separation of workloads, systems, and environments without embedding identity or policy decision logic, which are handled by dependent Secure Network patterns.

components.title: Zone Definition
components.description: Establishment and governance of discrete network trust zones.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Lateral movement enabled by insufficient or poorly defined segmentation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit zone definitions restrict lateral movement between trust domains.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define and enforce network segmentation to limit exposure.

components.title: Inter-Zone Traffic Control
components.description: Control and governance of traffic flowing between network zones.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Discovery of services across insufficiently controlled zone boundaries.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled inter-zone filtering limits reconnaissance and unauthorized access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrict information flow between network zones.

components.title: Lateral Movement Restriction
components.description: Prevention of unauthorized movement of traffic within and across zones.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized remote access and traversal between network segments.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Boundary enforcement reduces unauthorized lateral traversal.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce boundary protections to prevent lateral movement.
